stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.14 — Canonical Roux Block-preservation Ontology, Residual Reconstruction-consistency Fork & Fresh-route Gauge Authority Court

research_intent.primary_question: Can Roux reconstruction traces be prospectively partitioned into a state-defined canonical first-block-preserving second-block ontology and explicit residual forks without using outcome scores, and does that ontology remain usable on routes unseen by G3?
research_intent.secondary_question: Can the already resolution-capable G3 null architecture be frozen as a reference-only calibration object and applied without fallback to genuinely unseen canonical Roux routes?
not_the_question: whether a residual route was mentally intended as Roux
whether a first-block break is a cognitive error
population prevalence of any cognitive phenomenon

method_semantics_basis.role: external method semantics used only to motivate a prospective observable ontology; not treated as cognitive ground truth
method_semantics_basis.convergent_statement: Independent Roux method descriptions define SB as constructing the opposite 1x2x3 while preserving the already solved first block; common restricted move families are described as enabling this preservation.

route_entry_requirements: RAW_ALG_CUBING_LINK or equivalent raw reconstruction with setup and annotated algorithm
parseable under the frozen cubing.js grammar
final-state certified solved ignoring global puzzle orientation and center orientation
exactly one ordinary FB line; pseudo FB and FBDR are forked before primary ontology
a contiguous ROUX_SB annotation span after FB

frame.initialization: At the ordinary FB endpoint, enumerate 24 physical orientation representatives and 24 ordered block frames. Require exactly one orientation+frame pair with first block solved and opposite block not solved. This is prefix-only and cannot inspect the later SB outcome.
frame.transport: Only explicit whole-cube x/y/z rotations update the route gauge using the R1.13 group-action table derived by asymmetric-state invariance. Outer, wide and slice moves do not independently relabel the gauge.

canonical_fb_preserving.label: CANONICAL_FB_PRESERVING
canonical_fb_preserving.definition: From the state immediately after the ordinary FB endpoint through the first state-certified two-block completion inside the frozen contiguous SB span, the tracked first-block mask is solved at every state under the prefix-initialized, explicit-rotation-transported gauge. A unique first two-block completion must occur inside the SB span.

residual_forks.BLOCK_DISRUPTIVE_RESIDUAL: Prefix/frame is unique, but the tracked first block becomes unsolved at least once before any in-span two-block completion, whether or not it is later restored.
residual_forks.FB_PRESERVED_NO_COMPLETION_RESIDUAL: Tracked first block remains solved throughout the SB span, but no state-certified two-block completion occurs inside that span.
residual_forks.PSEUDO_FB_OR_FBDR_FORK: Annotation marks pseudo FB or FBDR; not eligible for the canonical ordinary-FB ontology.
residual_forks.SYNTAX_OR_STATE_INVALID: Raw reconstruction cannot be parsed or does not replay to a solved final cube.
residual_forks.ONTOLOGY_UNSCORABLE: Prefix gauge/frame or required phase span is not uniquely observable.

frozen_observation_operator.semantic_guard: Residual labels describe observable reconstruction-state behavior only. They do not declare a solve invalid, non-Roux, erroneous, intentional, or cognitively noncanonical.

ordering: Commit this NAPKIN and G4 inheritance ledger.
Only then read the live reco.nz index once and freeze the complete live ID set as G4_BASELINE_VINTAGE.

Routes present in that baseline but absent from all R1.13 development evidence are PREEXISTING_UNSEEN_HOLDOUT; they may test the G4 ontology prospectively but cannot count as post-freeze fresh-vintage authority evidence.
Only IDs absent from G4_BASELINE_VINTAGE and appearing in a later sealed watch are POST_FREEZE_FRESH_VINTAGE.
No route detail, method, reconstruction text, linkage, geometry, feature or null score may influence the baseline ID-set definition.
post_freeze_fresh_requires: reco_id absent from the baseline ID set
Roux method after the new row appears
not duplicated by official attempt key against any development/reference route when linkage is available
freshness_design.if_no_fresh_routes: Seal HOLD_DATA_WAIT rather than substituting development or baseline-preexisting routes.

authority_court.reference_bank: Freeze the G4-eligible canonical subset and its rebuilt attempt-level null from the development corpus before any POST_FREEZE_FRESH_VINTAGE route outcome is scored.
authority_court.minimum_add_one_resolution: reference bank must support p<=0.01 with add-one tails
authority_court.release_logic: Roux future scoring authority may be released only after all reference-bank, post-freeze freshness, geometry, scoring and integrity gates pass. A PREEXISTING_UNSEEN_HOLDOUT pass alone cannot release future authority.

prohibited_in_r114: reclassifying a residual after seeing its null score
changing the block-preservation definition after inspecting G4 route outcomes
calling canonical-vs-residual a cognitive strategy classification
